data.title: Mon3tr · 幽邃潮汐海蚀洞中的静默伏击休整
data.action: 单膝半蹲在海浪冲刷的黑色玄武岩洞穴边缘，单手按在湿冷岩石上，冷冽目光注视着洞外翻涌的墨绿海潮
data.location: 人迹罕至的深海潮汐溶洞与荧光藻暗礁
data.lighting: 幽暗洞窟内，水底发光藻类与泳装脊线散发出幽绿磷光，微弱月光从洞顶天窗垂直洒下冷冽白柱
data.mood: 冷酷警觉、非人异质美与绝对的忠诚守护
data.description: 潮水轰鸣着灌入玄武岩溶洞，碎沫在黑暗中被幽绿荧光点亮。Mon3tr半蹲在岩石突出部，黑色晶体质感的泳装上流转着源石般的翡翠微光，银白发丝在水汽中轻轻飘动。它转动眼眸，在水滴滴落的寂静间发出低沉的警惕共鸣，唯有在感知到熟悉信物时，冰冷的神情才稍显平息。
data.promptProse: Mon3tr crouches on one knee atop a slick basalt ledge inside a dark coastal cavern at night, wearing a textured black high-leg aquatic one-piece swimsuit traced with glowing emerald conduits and geometric cutouts. With one hand braced on the wet stone and sharp green eyes scanning the dark tide, she is lit by bioluminescent ripples and a narrow shaft of moonlight.
data.animaCaption: Crouching on one knee with a palm pressed to wet black basalt inside a tidal cavern, she watches alertly in a black high-leg swimsuit traced with glowing emerald lines. Bioluminescent green water ripples below while pale moonlight drops through a ceiling fissure.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a form-fitting black textured high-leg aquatic one-piece suit traced with luminescent emerald seams and geometric cutouts.
